description: This file defines a PHP class FileController that extends SugarController, responsible for handling file upload saving process within the SuiteCRM platform. It handles file validation, storage, and redirection after save.

classes.name: FileController
classes.description: Controller class for handling file upload save actions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_save
methods.description: Handles the process of saving an uploaded file and related database record, including validation, moving files, and redirecting.
